cause_quote: The commit initialized pause-only wakes with `batchRunIds: previous.requesterSettleWake?.batchRunIds ?? [entry.runId]` and remapped them with `{ ...resetRequesterSettleWakeRetry(wake), pauseNotice: undefined }`, leaving a pending completion wake on the adopted run.
user_saw: The requester could receive two completion announcements for one subagent follow-up.
summary: The fix drops pause-only wakes during follow-up adoption and preserves genuine requester completion cohorts with their frozen run identities.
reasoning: I checked the original adoption change and the parent of #161114, where an adopted follow-up could announce normally and wake inheritance carried existing requester completion state. #161114 began creating settle state for child-only pause notices and kept that state after clearing the notice during adoption, allowing requester settlement to race the ordinary completion announcement.
